info.title: 1POS API
info.description: Multi-tenant retail + restaurant POS API. Generated from route metadata and @1pos/validation schemas; money and quantities are decimal strings. See docs/api/CONVENTIONS.md.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_FAILED, CODE_TAKEN
